title: A practical guide to choosing an automation workflow
excerpt: Start with one measurable process, define its boundaries and review its output before expanding.
body:
## Start with one process

Choose a recurring task with clear inputs and outputs. Document when a person must review the result, then test it against real examples from your operation. Keep ownership explicit and measure errors as well as time saved.

Read the [automation overview](https://example.com/automation) and [contact the team](https://example.com/contact).
original_contribution: A bounded decision framework with explicit human review.
